facts: the narrator voluntarily gave the phone to a friend

reference_continuation: For the first minute I kept reaching into the empty pocket. Apparently my hand had a more serious relationship with the device than I did. After a while I stopped counting the minutes. When the phone came back, it contained several messages about things that had remained entirely possible without my immediate supervision.
continuity_question: Does the continuation develop being temporarily without the phone, rather than start an unrelated adventure?

reference_continuation: The little piece of paper looked remarkably confident about a journey I was not taking.
